name: Banana Pixel 2.3
animation: Programmed 2D rig using layers cut from own neural textures; not 3D reconstruction or full neural video.
local_edits: Face/body/accessory regions preserve pixels outside supported edits.
reference_support: Image import, color/transparency analysis and own finite-catalog recognizer. Not general VLM.
views: Own learned front, profile and back; left mirrors right. Not arbitrary 3D reconstruction.
cleanup: Flat-color targets, foreground/eye sampling, median and own palette cleanup of neural predictions.
compositional_scope: 6 own learned body forms,4 ear styles,3 tail styles; own previous learned facial/accessory patches. Not universal generation.
